remarks: HIGHEST AND BEST DEADLINE FOR OFFERS IS MONDAY 7/29/24 at 12 Noon. (Agents see confidential remarks.)  Desirable sunny corner unit in a modern, meticulously-maintained elevator building with reserved gated garage parking, gas heating/cooking, central AC, in-unit laundry. Nestled in a park-like setting, Carriage House is conveniently located on the Darien/Norwalk border, minutes to amenities, Metro North train. Under 1 mile to I-95. Unit #1312 is bright, stylish and welcoming, with a chic foyer, large entry closet, and an open concept floor plan that looks, feels and LIVES much larger than 1083 sq. ft. The fresh, all-white kitchen boasts tons of cabinet storage, uplighting, newer stainless steel appliances, a gas range and room for two chefs! The kitchen and breakfast bar are open to the living/dining rooms creating a great flow for entertaining - and everyday life.  A long hallway separates the living spaces from the bedrooms for added privacy. The oversized, sumptuous Primary Suite with two separate closets boasts the en-suite, Primary Bathroom. A second, amply-sized Bedroom with a massive closet can accommodate a Queen bed as well as a desk. Another full bathroom, recently renovated, is located just outside in the hallway.                    Included with Unit #1312: Indoor garage parking spot #10 with automatic garage door opener; Garage-level storage unit #18.  NOTE: No renting restrictions. Pet-friendly building.
